template.label: Artwork template
template.description: Choose how playlist artwork is generated.

option_descriptions.album_grid: Album covers arranged in a grid.
option_descriptions.album_fan: Album covers stacked as framed photo cards, slightly rotated (Apple Music style).
option_descriptions.album_grid_tilted: A grid with white gaps, tilted ~15° (Apple Music tilted-collage style).
option_descriptions.artist_mosaic: The most-played artist large in the centre, others as smaller tiles.
option_descriptions.artist_grid: Up to four unique artist images in equal tiles.
option_descriptions.artist_radio: The main artist centred on a solid background with overlapping circles.
option_descriptions.artist_banner: The playlist name over a full-bleed artist image (Tidal / Essentials style).

skip_provider_playlists.label: Skip provider playlists
skip_provider_playlists.description: When enabled, provider playlists (e.g. from Spotify or Tidal) that already have their own artwork are skipped. Playlists without any artwork still receive a generated collage.
